claims.description: The fixed JSON adapter requires element IDs and accepts string or integral JSONNumber IDs. This evidence does not make Python int conversion equivalent to the generated GWT conversion.

The generated importer resolves extended endpoints to nodes or ports and requires at least one source and target. Its source also contains a primitive-edge importer, which this host slice does not implement.

ADR-0002 accepts Python str including empty strings and exact Python int IDs, rejects bool and all floats, preserves numeric/string distinction and applies global typed node/port/edge uniqueness. Optional label IDs do not enter endpoint indexes; this is an explicit host rule, not complete GWT identity parity.

Graph imports and every export deep-clone JSON without changing key/list order, adding defaults, generating coordinates, dropping unknown business fields or stripping caller $H/error.stack. Shared acyclic children become independent copies.
Node order includes root preorder; port and edge order follows node preorder and original arrays. Read-only ordered indexes serve lookup and never decide a new model order.

Known structural containers must have declared array/object types; explicit width/height are finite nonnegative numbers and never bool. Primitive edges fail explicitly; nested nodes/ports/labels/multiple endpoints are data transport only. Every recognized node, port, edge, label and section requires any explicit layoutOptions container to be a Mapping; the model preserves its keys/values without parsing options or choosing scope precedence. This conservative host schema does not reproduce JS falsy-container acceptance.

Sections/points/references receive basic container, optional typed ID and explicit finite-coordinate validation. Section topology, connectivity, coordinate frames and orthogonal geometry are not validated. Business nesting with identical field names is only cloned.

set_property clones and validates a nonstructural value before atomic replacement on the owned working graph. Identity/relationship/section replacement is prohibited, preventing stale indexes and caller input mutations.

Anchor and Margin are internal keyword-only finite values; margins are nonnegative. Neither is injected into input/output JSON; no layout, renderer, worker, Java runtime or random stream is implemented.

limitations: Source fingerprints bind fixed elkjs adapter and generated worker, not an exact external Java build commit.
E03 tests establish host transport/validation/ownership only, not JS error-name/message parity or native layout/API/lifecycle acceptance.
The model can carry advanced topology which the E02 native-basic-layered-v1 comparison profile still excludes.
